§6Firebricks§f

§aEverything hot in HBM needs these. Blast furnaces, crucibles, you name it.§f

Firebricks start with §bFireclay§f. Mix clay with aluminium (or limestone with sand) to get fireclay balls, then smelt them into bricks.

They're the building block for the §bBlast Furnace§f, §bCrucible§f, §bBricked Furnace§f, and high-temp machine casings. You'll want a good stockpile before you start building anything serious.

Fireclay is a simple recipe, but you'll need a lot of it. One blast furnace alone eats dozens of firebricks.

§ePS:§f Use a §bBricked Furnace§f to smelt fireclay balls. It gets a 200% speed bonus for that exact job, so bulk production is painless.
